page.layout: One column of running text, with the paragraphs set full width. Below the text, one italic closing line. No marginal notes. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: solum temeratores alienarum nuptiarum gladio punit, sed & eos, qui cum masculis nefandam libidinem exercere audent.§.4.inst.eod.
Item Lex Cornelia de sicariis, quae homicidas ultore ferro persequitur, vel eos, qui hominis occidendi causa cum telo ambulant.§.5.inst. eod.

Lex Pompeja de parricidiis, qua cautum est, ut parricida neque gladio, neque ignibus, neque ulli alij solenni[?] poenae subjiciatur, sed insutus culeo cum cane, & gallo gallinaceo, & vipera, & simia, & inter eas fera-es angustias comprehensus (secundum quod regionis qualitas tulerit) vel in vicinum mare, vel in am-nem projiciatur: ut omnium elementorum usu vivus carere incipiat, & ei coelum superstiti, & terra mortuo auferatur.§.6.inst.eod.& l.unica, C.de his qui parentes vel liberos occiderunt.

Lex Cornelia de falsis, quae etiam testamentaria vocatur, poenam irrogat ei, qui testamentum falsum scripserit, signaverit, recitaverit, subjecerit: vel signū adulterinum fecerit, sculpserit, expresserit sciens dolo malo.§.7.inst.eod.
Lex Julia de vi publica seu privata adversus eos exoritur, qui vim vel armatam, vel sine armis commiserint.§.8.inst.eod.
Lex Julia peculatus eos punit, qui publicam pecuniam, vel rem sacram, vel religiosam furati fuerint. §.9.inst.eod.
Lex Flavia de plagiariis, quae interdum capitis poenam ex sacris Constitutionibus irrogat, interdum leviorem.§.10.inst.eod.
Sunt praeterea publica judicia, Lex Julia de ambitu, Lex Julia repetundarum, & Lex Julia de Annona, & Lex Julia de residuis.§.11.inst.eod.

p.i: Hactenus quatuor libri Institutionum iuris breviter traditi sunt.

page.notes: Printed page with running head DE RUDIMENTIS and page number 582. A stray mark at the top left and the stains at top right are not printed text and are left out. The word "solenni" is partly obscured at the line end and is uncertain. The hyphenation in "par-ricida", "pu-nit" and "ul-tore" is partly unclear at the line ends. "alij" is copied as printed. Long s is written as s throughout, and f in the scan is read as long s. The catchword DE is at the lower right.
